Class SubMillimeterWorld

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.spatial.SubMillimeterWorld
public class SubMillimeterWorld extends Object
Sub-Millimeter Spatial Coordinator. Bridges the World Editor Macro Grid (128x128x32) with Micro-Voxels (250 µm / 0.25mm resolution). Uses sparse chunk materialization and power-of-2 bitwise operations for high-performance memory management.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
